summary: ICICI Bank filed a Form 6-K disclosing credit ratings assigned to its USD 500 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes issued under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. Moody's assigned Baa3 and S&P Global assigned BBB on September 1, 2026. This is a routine debt issuance rating update under Indian listing regulations, not a special-situation corporate event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or strategic transaction is involved. The filing is informational only, with no impact on equity holders and no deal mechanics or terms applicable.
